summary: Represents a moppable area in the game.  This class manages the interaction of duplicants mopping liquid spills, integrating with the game's chore system, liquid simulation, and user interface. It handles the visual representation of the mop, its interaction with liquid chunks, and the display of relevant status messages to the player.

keyMethods.description: Initializes the moppable area upon prefab creation.  Sets up references to necessary game data, such as the mopping status item, tidying speed attribute, and skill experience.

Initializes the moppable area when it's placed in the game world.  Checks for the presence of liquid, creates a work chore for duplicants, adds it to the game's grid system and sets up event listeners for liquid changes and reachability.
Adds a 'Cancel Mop' button to the user menu when a moppable area is selected.

parameters.description: Event data (not used in this method).

keyMethods.description: Handles the cancellation of the mopping action by the player.  Closes the details screen and triggers an event.

Called when a duplicant stops mopping. Removes this object from the simulation scheduler.
Called when the mopping task is complete. Removes this object from the simulation scheduler.
